  • Analysis & Research Analysis & research to thoroughly analyze your business needs and market trends, creating a strong foundation for your web design project.

  • Websites Websites to elevate your brand and deliver exceptional user experiences through custom web design.
  • Design Systems Design systems to ensure consistency and scalability across all your digital platforms.
  • Landing Pages Landing Pages to capture leads and drive specific actions with high-converting and targeted designs.
  • Product Pages Product Pages to showcase your offerings and encourage conversions with optimized and compelling design.
  • Dashboards Dashboards to provide seamless access, analysis, and actionable insights through intuitive interfaces.
  • Apps Apps to meet your business goals and delight your users with user-friendly and tailored designs.
  • Brand Indentities Brand identities that resonate with an audience and effectively communicate brand values.
  • Newsletters Newsletters to engage your subscribers and reinforce your brand's voice through visually appealing designs.
  • Banners Banners to grab attention and drive clicks, enhancing your online campaigns with eye-catching visuals.
  • Icons Icons to enhance usability and add personality to your digital products with custom, unique designs.

  • Web Development

  • Analysis & Planning Analysis & planning to ensure everything is carefully planned and clear in advance.
  • WordPress Development WordPress development to make the website easily manageable, configurable, and publishing simple through a theme or plugin for WordPress, the world's most popular CMS.
  • WooCommerce Integration & Development WooCommerce integration & development to simplify shopping with the integration and extension of WooCommerce, the most popular ecommerce platform for WordPress.
  • WordPress Updates, Fixes & Security WordPress core, theme, and plugin updates, resolving WordPress technical issues, and strengthening WordPress website security to prevent vulnerabilities.
  • Accessibility Optimization Accessibility optimization to ensure the website's usability for all users, including people with disabilities, and compliance with modern standards.
  • On-page Search Engine Optimization On-page search engine optimization to ensure the website ranks well in search engines.
  • Performance Optimization Performance optimization to ensure the website is fast.
  • Server, Hosting & Domain Management Server, hosting & domain management to ensure the website's backend is stable, fast, and secure.
  • Post-deployment Support Post-deployment support to ensure systems are always up to date and secure.

  • Technology Stack

  • Creativity / Perfectionism / Enthusiasm We have an incredible sense of detail and will deliver the result of our work to you, fine-tuned down to the last pixel.

  • Creativity & Design

    • Figma Figma is a collaborative web application for user interface and user experience design.
    • Spline Spline is a 3D design software with real-time collaboration.
    • Adobe CC Adobe Creative Cloud is a bundle of professional tools like Photoshop and Illustrator that allows the creation of high-level graphics and illustrations.

  • WordPress

    • WordPress WordPress is the most popular open-source publishing platform and CMS powering almost half of the internet.
    • WooCommerce WooCommerce is a popular and open-source e-commerce plugin for WordPress.
    • WCS WordPress Coding Standards, a set of guidelines for writing consistent, clean, and maintainable code in WordPress development.

  • Web Accessibility

    • HTML HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is the standard markup language used to structure and display content on the web, defining elements like text, images, links, and forms.
    • WAI-ARIA WAI-ARIA helps make dynamic web content and applications more accessible, especially for screen reader users.
    • WCAG Web Content Accessibility Guidelines, a set of guidelines to ensure web content is accessible to people with disabilities, promoting inclusivity and equal access to digital information.
    • RTL RTL (Right-to-Left) refers to text and languages that are read from right to left, such as Arabic or Hebrew, and require specific styling for proper display on websites.

  • Web Styling

    • CSS CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is a stylesheet language used to control the layout and design of web pages, enabling the separation of content from presentation.
    • Less/Sass Less & Sass are preprocessors for CSS that extend its functionality with variables, nested rules, and functions, making stylesheets more maintainable and efficient.
    • PostCSS PostCSS is a tool for transforming CSS with JavaScript, allowing us to optimize, add features, and improve workflow.
    • PurgeCSS PurgeCSS is a tool for removing unused CSS from style sheets, reducing file sizes, and improving website performance.

  • Web Development

    • PHP PHP is a server-side scripting language used to create dynamic web pages, enabling the integration of databases, user authentication, and other interactive features.
    • PHPStan PHPStan is a static analysis tool for PHP that helps detect errors in code without running it, improving code quality and reducing bugs.
    • Security The security of our websites and web apps is essential for us.

  • Web Interactivity

    • Vanilla JavaScript Vanilla JavaScript refers to plain JavaScript without any libraries or frameworks, focusing on using the language's built-in features for web development.
    • jQuery jQuery is a fast, lightweight JavaScript library that simplifies HTML document traversal, event handling, and animation, making it easier to work with JavaScript across different browsers.
    • Security The security of our websites and web apps is essential for us.

  • Build Tools

    • Composer Composer is a dependency management tool for PHP, allowing developers to easily manage libraries and packages required for their projects.
    • NPM NPM (Node Package Manager) is a package manager for JavaScript, allowing developers to easily install, manage, and share libraries and dependencies for their projects.
    • Webpack Webpack is a module bundler for JavaScript applications that compiles multiple files into a single bundle, optimizing performance and managing assets like CSS, images, and fonts.
    • Bun Bun is a fast JavaScript runtime and bundler, designed to be a modern alternative to Node.js, with built-in support for package management, and optimized for speed and efficiency.

  • Servers

    • Ubuntu Server Ubuntu Server is a popular open-source operating system designed for servers, offering a stable and secure environment for hosting web applications, databases, and other network services.
    • Nginx Nginx is a high-performance web server and reverse proxy server, known for its speed, scalability, and ability to handle a large number of concurrent connections efficiently.
    • Apache Apache is a widely-used open-source web server that provides a robust, flexible platform for serving web content, supporting a variety of modules for customization and configuration.
    • PHP-FPM PHP-FPM (FastCGI Process Manager) is a PHP implementation designed to improve the performance of PHP applications by handling PHP requests more efficiently through process management and parallel execution.
